title: Cue the part being explained
statement: Cue the one element the narration is explaining at that moment, with a brief accent or arrow, so learners never have to search for it.
example: Across 103 studies and 12,201 learners, cueing improved retention by an effect size of 0.53 and transfer by 0.33.
detail: The grade-7 science visual design guide makes signalling a rule because a novice does not yet know which boundary, part or arrow matters, and a restrained cue turns visual search into guided inspection (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g7-science/brainlifts/video-visuals-human-v0.1.md`, lines 74-79). It cites a meta-analysis of 103 studies and 12,201 learners in which cueing improved retention (g+=0.53) and transfer (g+=0.33) and reduced cognitive load (Schneider, Beege, Nebel & Rey 2018). Its storyboard rule cues one current part with a reserved accent plus a shape, arrow or glow and dims earlier labels to about 60% (line 258), and the course's generation spec highlights the narrated element while it is narrated, one highlight at a time (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g7-science/brainlifts/video-generation-agent-v0.2.md`, line 35).
against: The guide expects signalling, like coherence, segmenting and pre-training, to add most when prior knowledge is low (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g7-science/brainlifts/video-visuals-human-v0.1.md`, lines 244-245), and another record cites a study in which added signals linking text and pictures were detrimental for students with high prior knowledge (Richter, Scheiter & Eitel 2018).

evidence.quote: **Evidence.** Across 103 studies and 12,201 learners, cueing improved retention (*g*+=0.53), transfer (*g*+=0.33), and reduced cognitive load [10].
A novice does not yet know which boundary, organelle, or arrow is diagnostic. A restrained cue converts visual search into guided inspection.
Cue one current part with the reserved accent plus shape, arrow, or glow; dim earlier labels to approximately 60%.
Reveal-while-explaining and highlight the narrated element WHILE narrated; ≤1 highlight at a time.
coherence, signaling, segmenting, and pre-training evidence all predict greater value when knowledge is low
